text_summary.body: In the second month of the second year of their coming, Zerubbabel, Jeshua and the Levites from twenty years old began the work; when the builders laid the foundation, priests with trumpets and Levites with cymbals sang "For he is good"; the people shouted, while old priests, Levites and heads of families who had seen the first house wept aloud, so that the sounds could not be told apart.

setting.body: Ezra 4:24 says the work stopped until Darius's second year (520); Ezra 5:16 says Sheshbazzar laid the foundations; Haggai 2:18 speaks of the day the foundation of the Temple was laid in the ninth month of Darius's second year, and Zech 4:9 of Zerubbabel's hands laying it.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VEBZB0TMKSFX4J334K6NEA
constraints.textual_assertion: in the second year of their coming to God's house at Jerusalem, in the second month
assumptions: The "second year of their coming" counted from the arrival; 1–2 years later (operator margin).

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VEBZB0TMKSFX4J334K6NEA
constraints.textual_assertion: Then ceased the work … until the second year of the reign of Darius
assumptions: Ezra's sequence; Batten (1913) instead places the foundation scene itself in 520.

constraints.subject: evt_01M4VEBZB0TMKSFX4J334K6NEA
constraints.textual_assertion: according to the grant that they had from Cyrus King of Persia
assumptions: Ezra's framework places 3:1–13 in Cyrus's reign (cf. 4:5). This is the text's chronology; the alternative placement under Darius is recorded as disputed.

competing_reconstructions.label: Foundation laid c. 536/535 under Cyrus; work then stopped until 520
competing_reconstructions.summary: Ezra 5:2 "began to build" means resumption; Hag 2:18 dates the prophet's word, not the foundation; Ezra 5:16 credits Sheshbazzar, the leader at the time.

competing_reconstructions.label: The foundation scene belongs to 520 under Darius; the Chronicler placed it under Cyrus
competing_reconstructions.summary: Haggai and Zechariah know of no earlier foundation; Ezra 3:6b–4:3 parallels the Aramaic account of the 520 rebuilding.

competing_reconstructions.label: Under Darius, in the second year after Zorobabel's arrival
competing_reconstructions.summary: Both place Zorobabel's return under Darius, so "the second year of their coming" falls in his reign.

competing_reconstructions.label: Unhistorical
proponents: W. H. Kosters (as reported by Batten and Ryle)
competing_reconstructions.summary: Rejected the account; Batten answers that the passage is a displaced but genuine parallel.

commentary.paraphrase: Guzik notes that the second month was when Solomon began his Temple (Kidner) and links the weeping of the old men with Hag 2:1–9 and Zech 4:8–10.
